product_overview: CallWaiting AI Chat Widget is an embeddable customer support and lead capture solution featuring advanced AI-driven text and voice interactions powered by OpenAI GPT-4 and MiniMax TTS integrations. It offers automated intelligent responses with voice synthesis, optimized for low latency and mobile responsiveness.
core_goals: Provide a seamless AI-powered chat interface with both text and voice modes.
Enable natural, context-aware AI responses with high-quality speech output.
Ensure ease of setup, testing, and deployment with comprehensive documentation and tools.
Deliver a scalable and affordable solution suitable for production environments.
Maintain robust security, error handling, and session management throughout the product.
key_features: Floating bubble chat widget with expandable UI.
Text chat mode with instant AI responses and loading indicators.
Voice chat mode featuring voice recording, timer display, and audio playback of AI responses.
AI integration using OpenAI GPT-4o-mini for intelligent and professional receptionist tone.
High-quality female voice TTS responses via the MiniMax TTS API with auto-play audio.
Multiple n8n workflow configurations for quick setup, AI + TTS integration, and production readiness.
Comprehensive testing tools including a command-line webhook tester and browser debugging.
Detailed step-by-step documentation covering setup, n8n workflows, troubleshooting, and deployment.
Responsive and elegant gradient UI with smooth animations for an engaging user experience.
Security measures such as API key protection, rate limiting, CORS policies, HTTPS enforcement, and input validation.
user_flow_summary: User visits a website with the embedded chat widget appearing as a floating bubble button.
User opens the chat widget and chooses between text input or voice recording for communication.
For text chat, user types messages and receives instant AI-generated text responses with loading states.
For voice chat, user activates the microphone, records a message, and stops to send; the AI processes and responds with synthesized speech.
The widget displays both the textual response and plays audio automatically if enabled.
All interactions are communicated via HTTP POST requests to the n8n cloud workflows which handle AI processing and TTS voice generation.
Users and administrators leverage included testing tools and documentation to validate function before production deployment.
validation_criteria: Chat widget UI loads correctly with floating bubble and expandable window on multiple browsers and devices.
Text input successfully sends user messages and receives AI-generated text responses within 3 seconds latency.
Voice recording captures audio input and transmits it to backend workflows for speech-to-text and response generation.
AI responses are context-aware, professional, concise (~100 words), and accurately synthesized into natural female voice audio.
Automated tests (`node test-webhook.js`) pass, verifying webhook and JSON response structure with text and audio_url fields.
Security protocols such as API key management, CORS restrictions, and HTTPS enforcement are implemented and tested.
Documentation provides clear guidance for setup, AI workflow import, testing, troubleshooting, and production deployment procedures.
Production deployment runs securely with enabled rate limiting and no critical errors on client or server-side logs.
Audio playback functions smoothly across supported browsers without delay or failure.
